package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
)

type bootstrapStarterFake struct {
	calls        int
	student, key string
	input        domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1
}

func (f *bootstrapStarterFake) Start(_ context.Context, student, key string, input domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultV1, bool, error) {
	f.calls++
	f.student, f.key, f.input = student, key, input
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultV1{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultSchemaV1, PlanID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", AttemptID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PlanDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", OnboardingVersion: 7, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}, f.calls == 1, nil
}

func TestDiagnosticBootstrapHandlerRejectsActorAndWireAdversaries(t *testing.T) {
	h := DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler{}
	wrapped := middleware.RequireStudent(http.HandlerFunc(h.Start))
	validID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	key := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, user, role, content, key, body string
		want                                 int
	}{
		{"role", validID, "TEACHER", "application/json", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1}`, http.StatusForbidden},
		{"space actor", " " + validID, "STUDENT", "application/json", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1}`, http.StatusForbidden},
		{"upper actor", "AAAAAAAA-AAAA-4AAA-8AAA-AAAAAAAAAAAA", "STUDENT", "application/json", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1}`, http.StatusForbidden},
		{"space key", validID, "STUDENT", "application/json", " " + key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
		{"media", validID, "STUDENT", "text/plain", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
		{"unknown", validID, "STUDENT", "application/json", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1,"course_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
		{"trailing", validID, "STUDENT", "application/json", key, `{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":1} {}`, http.StatusBadRequest},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			r.Header.Set("X-User-ID", tc.user)
			r.Header.Set("X-User-Role", tc.role)
			r.Header.Set("Content-Type", tc.content)
			r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", tc.key)
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			wrapped.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			if w.Code != tc.want || (tc.want != http.StatusForbidden && w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store") || strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "course_id") {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d cache=%q body=%s", w.Code, w.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), w.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	oversize := bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), 16<<10+1)
	r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", bytes.NewReader(oversize))
	r.Header.Set("X-User-ID", validID)
	r.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT_PRO")
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	wrapped.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	if w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("oversize=%d", w.Code)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticBootstrapHandlerSuccessAndReplayExposeOnlySafeResult(t *testing.T) {
	fake := &bootstrapStarterFake{}
	wrapped := middleware.RequireStudent(http.HandlerFunc(DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler{Bootstrap: fake}.Start))
	user, key := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	for n, want := range []int{http.StatusCreated, http.StatusOK} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1","expected_onboarding_version":7}`))
		r.Header.Set("X-User-ID", user)
		r.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT_PRO")
		r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		wrapped.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		if w.Code != want || w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Fatalf("attempt=%d status=%d cache=%q", n, w.Code, w.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
		}
		var raw map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(raw) != 7 || raw["schema"] != "diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap-result.v1" || raw["plan_id"] == nil || raw["attempt_id"] == nil || raw["plan_revision"] == nil || raw["plan_digest"] == nil || raw["onboarding_version"] == nil || raw["created_at"] == nil {
			t.Fatalf("unsafe response=%s", w.Body.String())
		}
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"course", "binding", "goal", "direction", "score", "band", "task", "route"} {
			if strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), forbidden) {
				t.Fatalf("leak %q: %s", forbidden, w.Body.String())
			}
		}
	}
	if fake.calls != 2 || fake.student != user || fake.key != key || fake.input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("input %#v calls=%d student=%s key=%s", fake.input, fake.calls, fake.student, fake.key)
	}
}
